title: Slate gate report
description: qa/gates.json in a film folder: the latest result of every gate (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6). Written by slate.gates.write_report; every result also lands in qa/history.jsonl. Only PASS counts as passed; UNCHECKED is never a pass; a result turns STALE when any input's sha256 changes.

generated.description: do not edit by hand: slate qa

gates.description: Gate name to its latest result.

result.description: One gate verdict with its evidence, the engine that measured it and the hashes of what it read.

summary.description: One line a person can act on.

engine.description: The tool that made the verdict and its version: the OCR engine and recognition level, the Whisper model, the ffmpeg build. Extra keys add detail.

inputs.description: What the gate read, each with the sha256 it had when checked: a film-relative (or absolute) path, or a named input (film:<dotted.key>, film:* for film.json without its bookkeeping, brand:<name>, format:<name>; see slate.state.lock). null for a file the gate expected but didn't find; 'unverifiable' for a named input of a kind Slate can't check.
